label: the dative-experiencer frame Spanish gustar needs
note: Closed by SA-C58-mahyam and SA-C58-rocate. `mahyam` is taught first as the dative of `aham`, hooked to the dative-of-purpose the track already taught in `punardarshanaya`; `rocate` then makes the thing liked the subject and agrees with it, which is the whole of the gustar shape.
